scope: User clarified jitter occurs while crossing straight without a turn. Audit only; no application changes.
procedure: Qualify an unmapped straight crossing; record commands on entry, during LOST/visible confirmation, and exit. Repeat encounter to test repeated brake boundaries.
Feed a continuously fresh 90 mm/s FOLLOW into the existing idealized Motion test plant; measure duty range/zero/reverse counts after settling.

Compile and run existing Motion default/guarded and Mission PID/binary tests. Compare current source and UF2 with INT-58. Optionally read dashboard SSE for a bounded interval without issuing commands.
expected: Report slow target, steering, stop boundaries, stable action identity and whether the nominal plant reproduces jitter. Clearly separate scripted software behavior from measured robot behavior.
physical_limits: No running firmware hash, high-rate wheel counts/duties, mounted sensor geometry or calibrated motor friction model.
